title: Calculating dN/dS Ratios with Codeml
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qhwdt7e

steps.title: Download and inspect data files
steps.instruction: Clone the pre‑compiled dN/dS repository from GitHub, change into the resulting dnds directory, and verify that it contains four files: an amino‑acid FASTA (.fna), a nucleic‑acid FASTA (.faa), a codeml control file (.ctl), and a Python parsing script (.py).

substeps.instruction: Confirm presence of the four files: *.fna, *.faa, *.ctl, *.py

steps.title: Align amino‑acid sequences
steps.instruction: Run Clustal Omega on the amino‑acid FASTA file to produce an alignment in FASTA format.

steps.title: Create codon‑aligned nucleotide file
steps.instruction: Use pal2nal to convert the amino‑acid alignment and the original nucleotide sequences into a codon‑based alignment in PAML format, removing gaps and in‑frame stop codons.

steps.title: Run codeml pairwise analysis
steps.instruction: Execute codeml in the directory containing the control file, ensuring the control file specifies the correct input and output names and runmode for pairwise comparisons.

substeps.instruction: Verify codeml.ctl contains: seqfile = cluster_2.pal2nal, outfile = codeml.txt, runmode = -2

steps.title: Parse codeml output
steps.instruction: Run the provided Python script to extract dN/dS results from the codeml output file, noting that pairs with dS = 2 are filtered out.
